purpose: Caption-diversity pair on the v9 rig-cogen recipe, 40k fresh cosine each. Arm 'canon': canonical single caption per action (control). Question: does breaking the one-fixed-string-per-action training signal lift prompt-motion alignment off chance on the validated retrieval metric (real ceiling top-1 59% / top-5 89%, chance 2.7%/13.5%)? Every prior lever was rejected (t5-base, rig-loss strength, training budget -- the 300k run showed alignment degrades past 40k). 40k budget sits at the measured alignment peak of the recipe family. Milestone evals at 10k/20k/40k with retrieval chained. Single seed per arm.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.
